newsitem.title: USA: Wicklund Holding to buy International Plastics.
newsitem.headline: Wicklund Holding to buy International Plastics.

text.p: Wicklund Holding Co said Monday it is holding talks on acquiring International Plastics Corp, a maker of plastic accessories for roads and bridges.
Exact terms of the deal have yet to be completed, said Wicklund, but the company plans to swap 3.9 million restricted shares out of a total of five million shares in public hands.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of January, said Wicklund.
Wicklund Holding owns oil and gas interests, said a company spokesman.
